note: B34-DEF-009. Records which supabase/migrations/*.sql files are recognized as the SAME logical migration under different historical filenames, so cross-branch filename drift is an explicit, approved decision instead of an unexplained duplicate. This manifest never causes an applied migration to be renamed or deleted -- see docs/migration-provenance.md.
normalization: Lines are trimmed of trailing whitespace; blank lines and no-op semicolon-only lines are dropped; the remaining lines are hashed with SHA-256. This treats '20260716035943_add_purchase_options_to_saved_scans.sql' (Android) and '20260717201524_20260716035943_add_purchase_options_to_saved_scans.sql' (iOS) as logically identical despite the iOS copy carrying one extra trailing ';' line that raw SHA-256 would otherwise flag as a content mismatch.

aliases.evidence: Neither staging nor production's migration ledger contains a version '20260716035943' entry -- only '20260717201524' (which carries this same SQL under a different filename) is applied in both. Confirmed 2026-08-29 via list_migrations on both projects.
Matches the ledger version '20260717201524' applied on both staging and production.
